
# Tomás Durães

> Personal portfolio of Tomás Durães, a programming student and junior software developer interested in Linux, macOS, software development, and computer systems.

## About

Tomás Durães is a programming student and technology enthusiast focused on software development, operating systems, and the relationship between hardware and software.

He enjoys experimenting with different technologies, configuring Linux environments, exploring macOS on non-Apple hardware, and building projects through practical experience.

His interests include Linux system configuration, declarative infrastructure, desktop customization, and software development.

## Development Approach

Tomás uses AI-assisted development tools for exploring ideas, prototyping features, and speeding up implementation.

AI-generated code is treated as a starting point rather than a finished product. He reviews, tests, and refines generated code as part of his development process.

This approach is also referred to as vibe coding or AI-assisted development.

## Projects

- [NixOS Configuration](https://github.com/quicktommy/nixos-config): Personal NixOS configuration featuring a customized Linux environment, Nix Flakes, Hyprland, Noctalia, and reusable configuration modules.

- [Hackintosh Tahoe EFI](https://github.com/quicktommy/IdeaPad-Gaming-3-15ARH05-Hackintosh): OpenCore EFI configuration and experiments with running macOS on non-Apple hardware, including configuration work for a Lenovo IdeaPad Gaming 3.

## Skills & Technologies

- Operating Systems: NixOS, Linux, macOS
- Desktop Environment & Customization: Hyprland, Noctalia, Zsh
- System Configuration: Nix Flakes, declarative configuration
- Hackintosh: OpenCore, EFI
- Development Tools: Git, GitHub
- Development Approach: AI-assisted development, prototyping
